description: Read a Google Doc: metadata (title, owner, last modified) and its plain-text content across all tabs. Useful to understand what the comments refer to.

document.description: Google Docs document ID or full URL (https://docs.google.com/document/d/<id>/edit).

include_content.description: Include the document text. Set false for metadata only.

max_chars.description: Maximum number of characters of content to return.
